title: Development event
description: A training, certification, talk or milestone — the record type that makes personal development countable over time. Kept separate from interaction because a training is not an exchange with a stakeholder, and folding it in would corrupt every meeting metric.

type.description: talk=one the owner gave or attended, recorded either way in notes | milestone=a marked step that is not itself a course or credential

project_id.description: Usually a learning or certification project, when one exists

provider.description: Organization or platform that delivered it

credential.description: Credential or certificate identifier, when the event produced one

hours.description: Effort in hours, when it is known and worth counting
